reviews.x: During this period of confinement (Covid 19), it has been hard to keep the kids busy. I purchased the chalk hair combs, and painted my wife and my hair. I will let you imagine the surprise on my kids' face when they saw us. We ended up spending a good portion of the day "painting" our hair in different colors, and when we were done, everybody showered and we got our hair back. No issue with the next morning video calls - HAHA. We still have plenty for at least 2 more uses (there are 5 of us - 4

reviews.t: Perfect gift for sharing with friends!
reviews.x: My kids could not wait to take this out of the box! It is so hard to find birthday gifts for one kid because the others can’t wait to play too. This hair chalk is the perfect gift because the birthday girl couldn’t wait to share! Easy, mess free, and washes out so nicely!

at first i thought it didn't work, then i read the instructions. whops. you have to wet your hair fist. We got this for our 4 year old to have mermaid hair for her birthday, she hair is light brown, the color lightly showed, but was not bright like the picture- that being said it washed out easily (we've had problems in the past with other brands)

Just received the box in the mail. 1st, the product is much smaller than expected. It was Mini on the box but not in the title and this is something that should be changed. The box was also bent, the orange chalk already broken near the center and the plastic on the blue coming off. It's a Christmas present and not enough time to go through the return process, so it's really unfortunate. Will update review after use.

So my 3 and 6 year olds love the idea of colored hair. I tried these combs because they looked like they worked, were easy to use, and they are cheap. Well, they kind of work, need lots of running over the hair to transfer the color, and the design of the comb pulls hair out. What's way worse in my opinion is that the consistency of the hair once colored is gummy, like you used play dough to color it. The color rubs off on the sides of their faces, clothes, my rug. I had to promise them I would

I think it is better to explain how I found it easier to use. 1. Wash hair 2. With hair still wet, make the hair do as you can not leave hair loose with this charcoal on in my opinion because the hair gets hard and ugly. I made brades. 3. After braided and still wet, remove from comb, I found it easier to remove from comb, apply to hair and top of braids. 4. Let it dry a little, apply hair spray and let it dry the rest before touching bed sheets and couch.

Worst ever. Bought for my daughters 9th birthday. Barely shows up at all, does not stay in period and makes the hair sticky, hard and just gross feeling overall. After my daughter used this and showered, her hair was still impossible to brush. Will never buy again. Threw away the day we opened it.

I got these specifically for the red and green for the Christmas holiday. They're fairly small, but easy to handle. But no matter how hard I pulled it against my hair I simply wasn't getting the color that I wanted. My hair is very blond/white/grey so normally any kind of this coloring stuff goes on easy and stays a long time with bright color. I bought it especially for the green because other brands are more Grinch-green and this looked like it was going to be a true Christmas green. But it ju

The pigment worked well on my blonde hair, I used the red and blue on damp hair and it came out exactly as I would have hoped. I wasn’t really able to style the hair after using the chalk without losing some of the color, so keep that in mind if you plan on curling or other styling. The only complaint I have is that the lids on the combs that hold the chalk in pop off easily. I spent a lot of time trying to hold the lid on so I could still use the comb and not get chalk on my hands. The chalk do

Ok, save your money... the combs, small and only succeed in snagging hair.  I took the chalk off the comb as suggested by other reviews and it worked better, but I think I ended up with more on my hands than in my daughter's hair... which is dirty blonde and as you can see, the color barely shows. Definitely not enough chalk to get a good bright color... that being said, she still thinks it's the coolest thing ever.

reviews.t: Perfect for adding a small pop of temporary color
reviews.x: I tested the red out on my curly black hair. I used it after I showered and had applied some curl creme to my hair. It took a few passes to get the color to really stick out but it stuck. Once my hair dried I didn’t have a problem with it rubbing off onto my shirt or pillow. It’s not super vibrant but it’s enough to tell that there is color. It was also super easy to wash out too.

I really wanted to like the colored hair chalk. My 6 yr old daughter loves to do her hair different colors so I thought this would be fun. They are very small brushes of chalk. They do not work very well even if I spray her hair down first. My daughter has ashy blonde hair. Only one color seemed to work well enough. I wouldn’t buy it again but we may use it on her dolls hair.

I'm not sure why the reviews for this item are so high. Our family was only able to get some color coverage from a couple of the sticks despite trying many different techniques with and without water on our toddlers light brown hair. The ends of the combs fall off constantly and so the "chalks" end up falling out and leaving a mess. Over all, very not impressed.

Many color options and super simple! My niece’s hair turned out pretty great! I tried it as well, the red color, but I have super dark hair and it wasn’t as visible. You have to go over it a good number of times with the comb, and if the instructions aren’t followed correctly it can get waxy or cakey feeling. Great for some easy fun that simply washes out!

My grandaughter loves to color her hair so i ordered this after she found it on amazon. The pieces of chalk kept falling out of the comb thing because the end would pop off everytime id comb it through her hair. That made it a constant problem. Some of the colors didnt show up well even after Appling it multiple times. It got more on me than the hair.

This is a terrible product...my daughter was very disappointed....it was very hard to apply ... had to rub a lot many times on hair ... still no visible color on brown hair ...& it turned hair very greasy & clumpy.... even after 4-5 washes the hair texture is terrible....total waste of time & money.....won’t recommend to anyone ...

I have bleached ends and so I tried the comb on that area.  Followed instructions and a slight hint of colour showed up and pieces of color from the comb came out. Went to brush my hair and you can tell where it was used on your hair as my brush got stuck and had to rip it through. Would not recommend.

Was a bit disappointed in this product. Bought as gift for 10 year old. Not easy to use and somewhat messy. Is similar to a soft crayon. Do not put on child and let them put head on furniture. While this is a fun and washable for kiddos to try their hand at hair fashion, not what we were looking for.

reviews.t: Does not work don’t waste your money
reviews.x: Bought this for Halloween for my daughter’s hair.  Tried it on all of my daughters.  Followed the instructions word for word and was able to get the tiniest amount of very faded coloring into their hair.  Also the comb was ripping strands of their hair out.  I wound up just throwing them all away.

I liked the handle that easily glided through my daugter's blonde hair.  The color showed nicely although it was not as vibrant as the picture shows.  But it did it's job and easily rinsed out of her hair.  I used it on dry and there was no need to wet the chalk.  I would recommend!

reviews.t: Great alternative to using permanent or semi permanent coloring
reviews.x: Bought this for my niece. She’s13 years old. She wants to color her hair like her friends but her parents don’t want her to use chemicals on her hair at her age. This was a great compromise! She loves it and it washed out without issues. It did seem to go on better wet.

Have order a few of these and ended up returning them. Figured I would give it another try and this one looks very nice and made it easy to only use a little bit!  As I got comfortable, I was able to add more for a deeper color! Super fun and washes out!

It’s good for tween girls. It was a little hard to get in her hair. I would say make sure the hair is damp when putting the color in. Seemed to work better. A little messy but not bad for the price and for a short time/temp use.

DO NOT BUY UNLESS YOU WANT PERMANENT BRIGHT PINK AND PURPLE HAIR!!! I bought these for my 4 year old for her Halloween costume and they did not come out!! We are getting her hair dyed which was NOT at all planned.

Did not like it. I mean its nice and easy to put on and clean off but its very oily. And when you have it on for so long (not even a day) it makes you hair look nasty, like you haven't washed your hair in days.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the chalk easy to use and wash out, making it a fun, kid-friendly activity or gift.
Several reviewers report the color barely shows up, especially on darker or light brown hair, even after multiple passes.
A common complaint is that the chalk pieces fall out of the comb or the comb snags and pulls hair.
Some reviewers note the product is smaller than expected and arrived with broken or damaged packaging.
Some reviewers mention the chalk leaves hair sticky, hard, waxy, or difficult to brush.
